basis: PREREG_H1_TF F12.3 (K+F tokens 0-38 with K blocks + probe columns 39-41), F12.5 (real token matrix for the outcome-free simulation), F12.8 (fields and K/SVD/probe extraction, CPU, measured); F5 schema pins (10 Nov 2026); Board A F12 review conditions 2, 6, 7

column_rules.0-15: vec(M_t) row-major, M_t = (Lambda_G^1/2 U_G^T B)(A U_A Lambda_A^1/2); zeros with flag k_cutoff_tie
column_rules.16-23: log sigma_j(D_t), natural log, untruncated fp32 thin SVD, 0 where absent
column_rules.34: 1 iff the tensor's layer type is full_attention (field module_roles)
column_rules.35-38: <g_t, D_t> (wikitext_nll, fp32 as response_field.contract), q_t (base spectral factors), c_t = 0 (roots), presence
column_rules.39-41: mlp.down_proj only: RMS_i of mean(D x)_i, RMS_i of RMS(D x)_i over the G2 probe cache (mean over a prompt's tokens, equal prompt weight), presence; 0 elsewhere (drafting default)
column_rules.eligibility: a row with a supported changed tensor lacking r, a finite SVD or a K frame is excluded
column_rules.presence: token present iff the tensor is one of the 186 matrix slots and D_t != 0 after rounding
column_rules.rank: adapter r (lora_sft; chain inner lora_sft), 1 (abliteration, random_dir and their chain roots)

probe_cache.hooks: A5.8.3 MLP writers, post-gating input of mlp.down_proj
probe_cache.pooling: mean over a prompt's tokens, then equal weight over prompts
